questions.solution:
To identify the word pair that does not belong to the group, let's analyse the relationships between the words in each pair:

Three of the pairs (Cow – Calf, Lion – Cub, Insects – Larva) are all related to stages in the life cycle (parent-offspring or developmental stages).

Dog – Bitch does not fit this pattern as it represents a gender-specific relationship within the same species rather than a stage in the life cycle.
